verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Weave versioning instrumented functions and a Playground for iterating on prompts. Nothing documents a prompt registry or a way to deploy or promote prompt versions to production without shipping code. Function/code versioning and prompt experimentation are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: trace, version, and collect feedback about your application
The Weave Playground simplifies the process of iterating on LLM prompts and responses
